_comment: Per-locale native-speaker review state. SOT for i18n_review_status mgmt cmd.
_schema: review_status in {production-ready, needs-native-review, unreviewed, stub}; reviewer/reviewed_at/notes recorded when an operator runs i18n_review_status --mark-reviewed.
